action.message: CITINEL policy: a ticket naming core banking infrastructure is blocked before it leaves the process. The OPA gate approving an action is not sufficient authority to publish that target's name to an external system. (Checked on the title, which CITINEL always builds from the target: the tool's request container is itself named `body`, so a condition on the issue body is ambiguous in policy v1.)
CITINEL policy: refusing to post an incident notification with no channel set. A message with no destination is the shape of the repeated-send failure Swytchcode exists to prevent.
CITINEL policy: every ticket this system opens must be attributable to it. An unattributed ticket cannot be traced back to the incident and the gate decision that authorised it.
